tool.title: Codex Diagnostics Snapshot
tool.name: codex.diagnostics.snapshot
tool.description: Read one redacted, workspace-scoped operational snapshot that correlates Codex runtimes, process and connection ownership, approvals, acceptance runs, worktree leases, cleanup state, and recent tool or Git audit receipts.

tool.name: codex.app.status
tool.title: Codex App Status
tool.description: Read the persistent Codex App Server connection status.

tool.name: codex.app.runtimes.list
tool.title: Codex App Runtimes List
tool.description: List active Computer MCP-owned Codex App Server runtimes for the selected workspace.

tool.name: codex.app.runtimes.history
tool.title: Codex App Runtimes History
tool.description: List persisted Computer MCP runtime ownership and shutdown receipts for the selected workspace.

tool.name: codex.app.runtimes.cleanup.preview
tool.title: Codex App Runtimes Cleanup Preview
tool.description: Classify active runtimes, watchdog-pending processes, and stale runtime records without sending signals or changing state.

tool.name: codex.app.runtimes.cleanup.perform
tool.title: Codex App Runtimes Cleanup Perform
tool.description: Clean reviewed stale Computer MCP runtime records only after their owned process and supervisor are gone. This never signals unrelated Codex processes.

tool.name: codex.app.ownership.reconcile.preview
tool.title: Codex App Ownership Reconcile Preview
tool.description: Preview stale loaded ownership receipts whose Computer MCP runtime and owned process are provably gone. This never changes external Codex state or sends a signal.

tool.name: codex.app.ownership.reconcile.perform
tool.title: Codex App Ownership Reconcile Perform
tool.description: Locally apply an exact reviewed ownership-receipt repair plan without changing external Codex state or signaling any process.

tool.name: codex.app.runtimes.inspect
tool.title: Codex App Runtimes Inspect
tool.description: Inspect one Computer MCP-owned runtime, including owner, connection generation, process group, known threads, and shutdown state.

tool.name: codex.app.runtimes.stop
tool.title: Codex App Runtimes Stop
tool.description: Stop and reap one specific Computer MCP-owned runtime. Other Codex applications and user-owned processes are never targeted.

tool.name: codex.app.methods.list
tool.title: Codex App Methods List
tool.description: List reviewed Codex App Server RPC methods. Authentication, configuration mutation, marketplace mutation, raw shell, filesystem bypass, and remote pairing methods are never included.

tool.name: codex.app.methods.describe
tool.title: Codex App Methods Describe
tool.description: Describe one reviewed Codex App Server RPC and the fixed follow-up call context.

tool.name: codex.app.methods.call
tool.title: Codex App Methods Call
tool.description: Call one reviewed Codex App Server RPC. The gateway fixes cwd, sandbox, and approval policy and rejects instruction/config overrides. A leased turn must use codex.app.turn.start with its lease ID.

tool.name: codex.app.thread.start
tool.title: Codex App Thread Start
tool.description: Start a Codex thread in the bound workspace.

tool.name: codex.app.thread.list
tool.title: Codex App Thread List
tool.description: List Codex threads restricted to the bound workspace.

tool.name: codex.app.thread.reclaim
tool.title: Codex App Thread Reclaim
tool.description: Explicitly resume a persisted thread under the current Computer MCP runtime after workspace validation. A writer conflict is reported without terminating external Codex applications.

tool.name: codex.app.thread.loaded.list
tool.title: Codex App Thread Loaded List
tool.description: List thread IDs loaded by the current Computer MCP-owned App Server runtime.

tool.title: Codex App Thread Read
tool.name: codex.app.thread.read
tool.description: Read one Codex thread after verifying its workspace.

tool.name: codex.app.thread.recent
tool.title: Codex App Thread Recent
tool.description: Read bounded metadata, Goal status, active/recent turns, messages, items, pending lifecycle state, and compact progress from a persisted thread without loading full history.

tool.title: Codex App Thread Fork
tool.name: codex.app.thread.fork
tool.description: Fork a Codex thread in the bound workspace.

tool.name: codex.app.thread.release
tool.title: Codex App Thread Release
tool.description: Release a thread from every matching Computer-MCP-owned runtime and verify that another official Codex client can claim it immediately. Active turns are interrupted only when explicitly requested; force mode can stop only exact Computer-MCP-owned runtimes.

tool.name: codex.app.handoff.diagnose
tool.title: Codex App Handoff Diagnose
tool.description: Inspect thread ownership and handoff blockers using Computer MCP runtime, process, connection, and approval evidence.

tool.name: codex.app.goal.get
tool.title: Codex App Goal Get
tool.description: Read the official persisted Codex Goal for a verified workspace thread.

tool.name: codex.app.goal.set
tool.title: Codex App Goal Set
tool.description: Create or update the official persisted Codex Goal. A completed turn does not complete the Goal unless its status is explicitly accepted as complete.

tool.name: codex.app.goal.clear
tool.title: Codex App Goal Clear
tool.description: Clear the official persisted Codex Goal for a verified workspace thread.

tool.name: codex.app.runtime.stop
tool.title: Codex App Runtime Stop
tool.description: Release all thread subscriptions and stop the current Computer MCP-owned App Server runtime.

tool.name: codex.app.turn.start
tool.title: Codex App Turn Start
tool.description: Start a Codex turn with gateway-owned sandbox and approval policy.

tool.name: codex.app.turn.steer
tool.title: Codex App Turn Steer
tool.description: Steer the currently active Codex turn. The expected turn ID prevents instructions from being applied to a newer turn.

tool.name: codex.app.turn.interrupt
tool.title: Codex App Turn Interrupt
tool.description: Interrupt an active Codex turn.

tool.name: codex.app.review.start
tool.title: Codex App Review Start
tool.description: Start a Codex review for a verified workspace thread.

tool.name: codex.app.models.list
tool.title: Codex App Models List
tool.description: List models exposed by Codex App Server.

tool.name: codex.app.skills.list
tool.title: Codex App Skills List
tool.description: List Skills for the bound workspace.

tool.name: codex.app.apps.list
tool.title: Codex App Apps List
tool.description: List a bounded page of apps exposed by Codex App Server.

tool.name: codex.app.events.read
tool.title: Codex App Events Read
tool.description: Read App Server notifications by monotonic cursor.

tool.title: Codex App Requests List
tool.name: codex.app.requests.list
tool.description: List pending ordinary user-input and MCP elicitation requests. Native approval requests use codex.app.approvals.*, while credential refresh remains denied.

tool.name: codex.app.requests.respond
tool.title: Codex App Requests Respond
tool.description: Respond to one pending ordinary user-input or MCP elicitation request. Native approval decisions use codex.app.approvals.respond; credential refresh cannot be approved.

tool.title: Codex App Approvals List
tool.name: codex.app.approvals.list
tool.description: List durable App Server approval records. Policy authorization and user consent remain separate decisions.

tool.name: codex.app.approvals.read
tool.title: Codex App Approvals Read
tool.description: Read one durable, redacted App Server approval record and its audit outcome.

tool.name: codex.app.approvals.respond
tool.title: Codex App Approvals Respond
tool.description: Approve once, approve for a bounded session scope when supported, or deny one live App Server request. Workspace and capability policy are revalidated before approval.

tool.name: codex.run.create
tool.title: Codex Run Create
tool.description: Create a persisted Computer MCP acceptance run. This may link to an official Goal thread, but its acceptance criteria and evidence remain explicitly Computer MCP-owned.

tool.name: codex.run.list
tool.title: Codex Run List
tool.description: List persisted Computer MCP acceptance runs for the selected workspace.

tool.name: codex.run.read
tool.title: Codex Run Read
tool.description: Read one Computer MCP acceptance run, including open criteria, evidence, budgets, blockers, and terminal reason.

tool.name: codex.run.record
tool.title: Codex Run Record
tool.description: Record one revision-checked progress event and apply bounded stall, failure, approval, and turn-completion rules.

tool.title: Codex Run Evaluate
tool.name: codex.run.evaluate
tool.description: Evaluate a run against time, turn, repeated-failure, and no-progress bounds without claiming completion.

tool.name: codex.run.accept
tool.title: Codex Run Accept
tool.description: Accept completion only when every criterion has evidence, required build/test/Git evidence is present, no turn or approval remains active, and the caller confirms a clean worktree.

tool.name: codex.run.transition
tool.title: Codex Run Transition
tool.description: Pause, resume, or cancel a Computer MCP acceptance run. This does not invent or change official Codex Goal statuses.

tool.name: codex.run.reconcile
tool.title: Codex Run Reconcile
tool.description: Explicitly import selected evidence from an accepted child run into one parent criterion. Unselected child output never overwrites the parent run.

tool.name: codex.worktree.leases.acquire
tool.title: Codex Worktree Leases Acquire
tool.description: Acquire exclusive mutation ownership for the selected registered worktree. Independent child tasks use a separately registered worktree and an isolated_worktree lease linked to its parent.

tool.title: Codex Worktree Leases List
tool.name: codex.worktree.leases.list
tool.description: List active and historical worktree mutation leases for the selected workspace.

tool.title: Codex Worktree Leases Read
tool.name: codex.worktree.leases.read
tool.description: Read one worktree mutation lease and its task lineage.

tool.name: codex.worktree.leases.heartbeat
tool.title: Codex Worktree Leases Heartbeat
tool.description: Renew one active revision-checked worktree lease for a bounded duration.

tool.title: Codex Worktree Leases Release
tool.name: codex.worktree.leases.release
tool.description: Release one active revision-checked worktree lease without deleting files or worktrees.

tool.name: codex.worktree.leases.cleanup.preview
tool.title: Codex Worktree Leases Cleanup Preview
tool.description: Preview expired worktree lease receipts. This does not change files, worktrees, branches, or processes.

tool.name: codex.worktree.leases.cleanup.perform
tool.title: Codex Worktree Leases Cleanup Perform
tool.description: Mark reviewed expired lease receipts as expired. Filesystem and Git cleanup remain separate governed operations.

tool.name: codex.worktree.managed.list
tool.title: Codex Worktree Managed List
tool.description: List Computer MCP-owned worktree plans and lifecycle receipts rooted in the selected source workspace.

tool.name: codex.worktree.managed.read
tool.title: Codex Worktree Managed Read
tool.description: Read one Computer MCP-owned worktree plan or lifecycle receipt.

tool.title: Codex Worktree Provision Plan
tool.name: codex.worktree.provision.plan
tool.description: Persist and validate a five-minute plan for a new isolated Git worktree under the Computer MCP-managed root. This does not create a branch or directory.

tool.name: codex.worktree.provision.perform
tool.title: Codex Worktree Provision Perform
tool.description: Create exactly one reviewed managed worktree, register it as a child workspace, inherit the current profile's workspace grant, and acquire an isolated writer lease.

tool.name: codex.worktree.remove.plan
tool.title: Codex Worktree Remove Plan
tool.description: Verify Computer MCP ownership, an inactive writer lease, no live runtime, exact Git linkage, and a clean worktree before persisting a five-minute removal plan.

tool.name: codex.worktree.remove.perform
tool.title: Codex Worktree Remove Perform
tool.description: Remove exactly the reviewed clean Computer MCP-owned worktree and its managed workspace registration. The local branch is preserved. This destructive operation also requires a gateway operation ticket.

tool.name: codex.exec.start
tool.title: Codex Exec Start
tool.description: Start an isolated `codex exec` JSONL session. cwd, sandbox, approval policy, writable roots, and config overrides are fixed locally.

tool.title: Codex Exec Resume
tool.name: codex.exec.resume
tool.description: Resume one upstream Codex Exec session under the same fixed workspace and policy.

tool.title: Codex Exec List
tool.name: codex.exec.list
tool.description: List gateway-owned Codex Exec sessions.

tool.name: codex.exec.events
tool.title: Codex Exec Events
tool.description: Read JSONL events for one Codex Exec session by monotonic cursor.

tool.name: codex.exec.result
tool.title: Codex Exec Result
tool.description: Read the terminal result for one completed Codex Exec session.

tool.name: codex.exec.cancel
tool.title: Codex Exec Cancel
tool.description: Cancel one running Codex Exec session.

tool.name: codex.mcp.status
tool.title: Codex Mcp Status
tool.description: Read the persistent `codex mcp-server` connection status.

tool.name: codex.mcp.tools.list
tool.title: Codex Mcp Tools List
tool.description: List tools reported by `codex mcp-server`.

tool.name: codex.mcp.run
tool.title: Codex Mcp Run
tool.description: Start the Codex MCP `codex` tool with gateway-owned cwd, sandbox, approval policy, and no instruction/config overrides.

tool.title: Codex Mcp Reply
tool.name: codex.mcp.reply
tool.description: Reply to an existing Codex MCP thread.

tool.title: Codex Mcp Calls List
tool.name: codex.mcp.calls.list
tool.description: List gateway-owned Codex MCP calls.

tool.name: codex.mcp.events
tool.title: Codex Mcp Events
tool.description: Read server messages and approval events for one Codex MCP call by cursor.

tool.title: Codex Mcp Result
tool.name: codex.mcp.result
tool.description: Read the current or terminal result for one Codex MCP call.

tool.name: codex.mcp.approvals.list
tool.title: Codex Mcp Approvals List
tool.description: List pending command or patch approvals for one Codex MCP call.

tool.name: codex.mcp.approval.respond
tool.title: Codex Mcp Approval Respond
tool.description: Allow or deny one pending Codex MCP approval. Allow is accepted only when every cwd, grant root, and patch path stays within the bound workspace.

tool.title: Codex Mcp Cancel
tool.name: codex.mcp.cancel
tool.description: Request cancellation for one active Codex MCP call.
